name: chart-export
title: Chart export
description: Helpers that serialise a SheenUI chart to SVG, PNG and CSV. Used by the chart export menu.
author: lokendra-builds <https://github.com/lokendra-builds>
docs:
Chart export: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/charts

Installed in components/sheenui/charts/. A helper module that the other items import; you rarely import it yourself.

Next.js: this item takes function props (formatters, seriesLegend(), a dashboard's load), and a Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component. Use it from a file that starts with "use client".
